name: workflow_load
description: Load a workflow definition and register the workflow execution tools for the current session. Works exactly like skill_load: the workflow JSON is loaded from .opendora/workflows/<id>.json, and the workflow_* tools (workflow_create, workflow_run_step, workflow_complete_step, workflow_goto, workflow_finish) are registered for this session. After loading, call workflow_create to instantiate a run, then use the other workflow_* tools to execute it step by step. The workflow defines a tree of steps (task, sequence, parallel, foreach, decide) that the agent walks through.

name.description: The workflow identifier to load (matches the filename in .opendora/workflows/ without .json extension).
